name: tovu-desktop
description: Electron shell around the same Tovu the web mode serves. Additive: nothing outside this directory knows it exists.

scripts.build: npm run build:preload && npm run build:renderer
scripts.build:preload: rm -rf dist/preload dist/contracts dist/speech && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json && esbuild src/speech/preload-speech.cts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=dist/speech/preload-speech.cjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc -p tsconfig.live-verify.json
scripts.package: npm run gates && npm run build && npm run stage && electron-builder --mac && node scripts/verify-package.ts
